json_pointer.description: Complete RFC 6901 pointer with any number of reference tokens; '~' is valid only as '~0' or '~1'. This pattern is deliberately identical to the semantic validator's JSON_POINTER so schema and semantic layers agree.

fragment.description: RC-027: the exact preserved source text a directly_stated requirement was taken from.

fragment_digest.description: RC-027: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of `fragment`. A requirement claiming directly_stated authority against a byte-backed source must carry a statement_digest equal to this value.

contract_identity.description: EM-026: exact accepted-contract identity, required when kind is `contract`.

contract_version.description: EM-026: exact accepted-contract version, required when kind is `contract`.

allOf.$comment: EM-026: an accepted-contract source must identify the exact contract identity, version, and content digest. Source kind alone never establishes accepted-contract authority.
RC-027: a preserved source fragment must carry its digest so statement provenance is checkable.
